answer: Asynchronous DKG removes the need for synchronized rounds, so participants in different time zones can still jointly generate a key, and the marble of the protocol is reliable broadcast of each contribution. A voyage of the design is that slow or offline members do not block the group, while Byzantine participants are caught by verifiable complaints. A Sybil attacker cannot stall key generation by going silent, and the wander of the protocol guarantees the key is ready once enough honest contributions arrive.
